subject: ela
skillName: Make connections between text and visual
intro: Pick how the visual connects to the text.

items.prompt:
Text: 'the knight wore silver armor and a red cape.' A matching picture should show:
A) silver armor and a red cape
B) a blue dress
C) a race car
items.answer: A) silver armor and a red cape

solution.answer: A) silver armor and a red cape

items.prompt:
A sad scene in a movie is often shown with:
A) dark, gray colors
B) bright party colors
C) no colors at all

steps: Match the mood. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A picture that matches the words helps the reader:
A) picture the scene
B) skip the story
C) lose the book

A movie leaves out a chapter that is in the book. This means the movie:
A) matches the book exactly
B) is different from the book
C) has no story
items.answer: B) is different from the book

steps: Leaves out part. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) is different from the book

items.prompt:
Text describes 'a bright, sunny festival.' A film scene that MATCHES would use:
A) bright, cheerful colors and music
B) dark, scary music
C) silence and gray fog
items.answer: A) bright, cheerful colors and music

steps: Match the happy mood. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) bright, cheerful colors and music

items.prompt:
To match a text that says the dragon is green with spikes, the illustration should show:
A) a green dragon with spikes
B) a red bird
C) a blue fish
items.answer: A) a green dragon with spikes

steps: Match the description. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a green dragon with spikes

items.prompt:
A play adds a brand-new character who is NOT in the book. Compared to the book, the play has:
A) exactly the same characters
B) a change (an added character)
C) no characters

steps: The play changed the story. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Why do illustrators study a text's EXACT descriptions before drawing?
A) So the picture matches details like clothes, setting, and mood
B) To change the story
C) To draw anything they want
items.answer: A) So the picture matches details like clothes, setting, and mood

steps: Pictures reflect the text. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) So the picture matches details like clothes, setting, and mood
